messages:
monitoring-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate + tail latency observed in ap-southeast-2 for Hosted API (prod) and multiple Dedicated pools. Error signature: sts.amazonaws.com timeouts (~504), and observability ingestion errors. Triggered at 2026-03-15T02:46Z. Paging oncall.

jen (oncall-sre): I'm on it. seeing sustained 5xx% ~7% on /v1/generate and increased p95 to 1200ms for dedicated pools in ap-southeast-2. STS latency spikes correlate with auth retries in the logs.

ali (eng-infra): Confirmed. KV-cache hits fine. Problem looks upstream to AWS STS in ap-southeast-2. We have multiple auth failures: "GetSessionToken timeout after 10s" from our auth-proxy to sts.amazonaws.com.

frank (ops): Noting outbound egress to AWS APIs from the region shows elevated RTOs. Cloud provider status page shows partial degradation but not full outage. Opening AWS case now.

aws-support-bot: Case opened: 987654321 — AWS investigating elevated STS latencies in ap-southeast-2. ETA unknown. Will post updates to case.

maya (cust-success): Which customers are impacted? any high-touch accounts on Dedicated in that region? Need to prepare comms ASAP.

jen (oncall-sre): Early impact calc: ~18 Dedicated pools with >5% error, ~1.2k Hosted API requests/min with elevated retries. I'll export list to #support-runbooks — tagging @maya with the CSV.

ali (eng-infra): Short-term mitigation proposals:
- Route auth calls to STS regional failover (us-west-2) by toggling auth_region_override for ap-southeast-2 cluster (risk: increased latency)
- Enable local token-cache fallback (already available) to reduce immediate STS calls
- Disable nonessential 3rd-party telemetry flushes to free egress bandwidth

frank (ops): I'd prioritize enabling token-cache fallback + reduce STS calls. Rolling region failover has more blast radius.

jen (oncall-sre): Agreed. Starting token-cache local fallback now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-infra/token-cache-fallback @ ap-southeast-2 (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%)

jen (oncall-sre): Canary at 10% applied to a subset of hosted front-ends. Early telemetry: 5xx rate for canary hosts down 60%, p95 down ~300ms. Rolling to 50%.

lloyd (product): Any customer-visible degradation besides increased latency/errors? We need to triage billing/SLAs.

maya (cust-success): Internal note: 3 enterprise customers have Dedicated pools in ap-southeast-2 (ACME, Macrolytics, SafeBank). I'll message account leads and open postman entries.

jen (oncall-sre): Rolling to 100% token-cache fallback. Applying temporary rate-limiting to non-auth-critical endpoints to preserve capacity.

observability-bot: DataDog: agent telemetry for ap-southeast-2 shows 17% of spans dropped between 02:40-02:55Z. Logs ingest to central splunk API returning 503 for some batches.

ali (eng-infra): Temporarily disabling high-volume logs flush from dedicated workers to reduce egress. Also spinning up dedicated relay in us-west-2 for log ingestion.

frank (ops): AWS case update: "We are investigating STS throttling/egress issues in ap-southeast-2. Networking team seeing packet loss to STS endpoints." No ETA yet.

jen (oncall-sre): Current status: 5xx rates have fallen to ~1.2% (from 7%). p95 latency trending down to 420ms. Token-cache fallback + log batching change helped.

maya (cust-success): Communicated to ACME + Macrolytics: impact described, mitigation steps, ETA unknown. SafeBank requested explicit confirmation when normal operation resumes.

lloyd (product): Recommending we enable cross-region routing for new requests as a contingency (route to nearest healthy region for Hosted API). Ops/infra to evaluate.

ali (eng-infra): I'll run a risk assessment. Cross-region routing needs quick verification of model availability and cache warming cost. Could be next step if STS doesn't stabilize.

aws-support-bot: AWS update: "Partial recovery observed for STS in ap-southeast-2. We recommend clients to retry with exponential backoff. Continue to monitor." (posted 02:58Z)

jen (oncall-sre): We'll keep token-cache fallback for another hour, then gradually revert if AWS stays stable. Keeping rate-limits for nonessential endpoints for 30m.

frank (ops): Preparing runbook summary and incident timeline for postmortem. Capturing metrics, AWS case, config toggles (token-cache=true, auth_region_override=none).

maya (cust-success): Sending an update email to affected accounts now. I'll include mitigation steps and ask customers to route urgent tickets here.

lloyd (product): Good work. Once stable, let's schedule a short RCA with infra + oncall to discuss longer-term fixes (e.g., regional STS failover, cached credentials expansion).

jen (oncall-sre): Marking incident as investigating -> mitigated. Continuing to monitor for next 2 hours. If we see re-escalation, re-open pager. :white_check_mark:

monitoring-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: ap-southeast-2 STS latency reduced below threshold at 03:12Z. No active pages.
